dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Phase 0 foundations are in place. Fleet, customer and contract data arrive in Phase 1.
dashboard.notYetBody1: These tiles deliberately show only what exists. The KPIs from SOW §3 — fleet counts, monthly revenue, cost, profit, customer outstanding, supplier payables, expiring documents — are milestone 1E, and each will be an aggregation over the ledger rather than a stored column.
dashboard.notYetBody2: Showing placeholder numbers now would make the system look further along than it is.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.subtitle: Rentals and lease-to-own agreements, their payment schedules and what has been paid.
contracts.newSubtitle: A draft has no schedule yet. Activating it generates every instalment and puts the car on the contract.
contracts.paymentRecordedWithCredit: Payment recorded. {credit} was more than everything owed and is held as credit.

detail.vatNote: Terms are shown net of VAT. The schedule and payments are gross, as invoiced.
detail.activateHint: Activating generates every instalment, issues what is due today, and puts the car on this contract.

payment.title: Record a payment
payment.amountHint: As paid, VAT included. Applied to the oldest amount owed first.

vehicles.subtitle: Every car in the fleet, owned or leased in, with its status, mileage and documents.

defaultDescriptions.super_admin: Full access to every part of the system, including user and role management.
defaultDescriptions.admin: Customers, vehicles, suppliers, contracts, payments, reports and profitability. Cannot manage users or roles.
defaultDescriptions.sales: Leads, deals, customer information, documents and the deal calculator. Sees only their own leads.
defaultDescriptions.finance: Payments, receivables, supplier payments, expenses and financial reports.
defaultDescriptions.operations: Vehicles, maintenance, insurance, registration, accidents, fines and handover/return.
